subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` adopt recovery-first behavior after an accepted Gateway disconnect, with automatic isolated embedded fallback only after recovery is exhausted?
rationale: This changes the documented and current user-facing fallback contract, including whether the CLI waits for the authoritative run or promptly returns a newly executed fallback result; code review cannot choose that product tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
options.body: Wait and cache-replay the accepted Gateway run first, then retain the current fresh-session embedded fallback only when recovery cannot establish an outcome.

options.title: Keep automatic fallback as the primary behavior
options.body: Retain current main behavior and close or substantially narrow this PR because duplicate-side-effect prevention does not outweigh the changed interactive failure contract.

options.title: Fail closed after ambiguous recovery
options.body: Require an explicit opt-in rerun mode instead of an automatic fallback, with updated CLI contract and fresh-install/upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Wait and cache-replay the accepted Gateway run first, then retain the current fresh-session embedded fallback only when recovery cannot establish an outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current fresh-session containment behavior and are the clearest history-backed routing candidate for its successor contract.
